patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: (Bystander) She dropped and started convulsing — full-body shaking for a couple of minutes, bit her tongue. It stopped on its own. She's coming around now but she's groggy and confused.
clinical.presentationShort: 35yo F — witnessed generalized tonic-clonic seizure ~2 min, tongue laceration, now postictal and rousable — seizure.
clinical.presentationLong: 35-year-old female with a witnessed generalized tonic-clonic seizure lasting about two minutes with a tongue laceration, now postictal but rousable.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → protect airway, check glucose, labs/levels, identify trigger; observe recovery. Prolonged/repeat → status pathway.
diagnosis.why: Check a glucose in every seizure. Most self-terminate; if it doesn't stop or she doesn't wake up, treat as status.
diagnosis.redFlag: Seizing >5 min or not recovering = status epilepticus — a true emergency.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: slumped and dazed, being supported in the chair
signs: a little blood at the lip
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 35-year-old woman, groggy and dazed, slumped on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: slumped and supported, head heavy. Expression: dazed and confused, a postictal look. Clearly visible: an unfocused dazed gaze and a small bit of blood at the lip. No text, no logos.
